The **Training** group of the node palette has 33 nodes: all run.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Adagrad](../training/adagrad.md) | Runs | Per-parameter adaptive learning rates from accumulated squared gradients. |
| [Adam](../training/adam.md) | Runs | Adaptive moment estimation optimizer. |
| [AdamW](../training/adamw.md) | Runs | Adam optimizer with decoupled weight decay. |
| [BCE Loss](../training/bce-loss.md) | Runs | Binary cross-entropy loss for probability predictions. |
| [BCE with Logits](../training/bce-with-logits.md) | Runs | Numerically stable binary cross-entropy loss for logits. |
| [Contrastive Loss](../training/contrastive-loss.md) | Runs | Pulls same-class pairs together and pushes other pairs at least a margin apart. |
| [Cosine Embedding Loss](../training/cosine-embedding-loss.md) | Runs | Turns same-class pairs to the same direction and other pairs below a cosine margin. |
| [Cosine LR](../training/cosine-lr.md) | Runs | Anneals the learning rate along a cosine to eta_min over T_max epochs. |
| [CrossEntropy / Token CE](../training/crossentropy-token-ce.md) | Runs | Class or token-level cross-entropy loss. |
| [Embedding Output](../training/embedding-output.md) | Runs | Writes the trained encoder's embeddings of a partition to a Parquet file. |
| [Exponential LR](../training/exponential-lr.md) | Runs | Multiplies the learning rate by gamma after every epoch. |
| [Focal Loss](../training/focal-loss.md) | Runs | Focal loss for imbalanced multiclass classification logits. |
| [Huber Loss](../training/huber-loss.md) | Runs | Huber loss implemented by the equivalent Smooth L1 objective. |
| [Jaccard / IoU Loss](../training/jaccard-iou-loss.md) | Runs | Jaccard/IoU loss for probability masks and same-shaped Float32 targets. |
| [L1 Loss](../training/l1-loss.md) | Runs | Absolute-error loss for same-shaped regression values. |
| [MSE Loss](../training/mse-loss.md) | Runs | Squared-error loss for same-shaped numeric predictions and targets. |
| [NAdam](../training/nadam.md) | Runs | Nesterov-accelerated Adam optimizer. |
| [NLL Loss](../training/nll-loss.md) | Runs | Negative log-likelihood loss for log-probability inputs. |
| [Output](../training/output.md) | Runs | Declare the model or training workflow output. |
| [Pair Dataset Builder](../training/pair-dataset-builder.md) | Runs | Turns each batch of class-labelled rows into same-class and different-class pairs. |
| [Pair Metrics](../training/pair-metrics.md) | Runs | Measures how well a metric model tells same-class pairs from other pairs. |
| [Pair Score Output](../training/pair-score-output.md) | Runs | Sets how the trained model scores pairs when it is served. |
| [Reduce LR](../training/reduce-lr.md) | Runs | Cuts the learning rate when the validation loss stops improving. |
| [Retrieval Metrics](../training/retrieval-metrics.md) | Runs | Measures how well a metric model finds rows of the same class among their nearest neighbours. |
| [RMSprop](../training/rmsprop.md) | Runs | Adaptive optimizer using a moving average of squared gradients. |
| [SGD](../training/sgd.md) | Runs | Stochastic gradient descent with momentum, Nesterov and weight decay. |
| [Smooth L1 Loss](../training/smooth-l1-loss.md) | Runs | Smooth L1 loss for robust regression. |
| [Soft Dice Loss](../training/soft-dice-loss.md) | Runs | Soft Dice loss for probability masks and same-shaped Float32 targets. |
| [Step LR](../training/step-lr.md) | Runs | Multiplies the learning rate by gamma every step_size epochs. |
| [Triplet Dataset Builder](../training/triplet-dataset-builder.md) | Runs | Turns each batch of class-labelled rows into anchor, positive and negative rows. |
| [Triplet Loss](../training/triplet-loss.md) | Runs | Pulls same-class embeddings together and pushes other classes at least a margin further away. |
| [Tversky Loss](../training/tversky-loss.md) | Runs | Tversky loss for imbalanced probability masks and same-shaped Float32 targets. |
| [Warmup LR](../training/warmup-lr.md) | Runs | Ramps the learning rate up linearly over the first epochs. |
